计算机视觉/CV.title: Music-to-Dance Generation via Atomic Movements
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 通过原子动作进行音乐到舞蹈的生成
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Music-driven dance generation aims to produce human motion that is both rhythmically synchronized and semantically consistent with music. While recent neural approaches have achieved impressive visual realism, they typically model motion as a continuous signal and neglect its compositional nature, m
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 音乐驱动的舞蹈生成旨在产生与音乐节奏同步且语义一致的人体运动。尽管最近的神经方法取得了令人印象深刻的视觉真实感，但它们通常将运动建模为连续信号，忽略了其组合性质。本文提出基于原子动作的舞蹈生成方法，将舞蹈分解为基本动作单元，通过组合这些原子动作生成复杂舞蹈，提高了生成舞蹈的多样性和可解释性。主要贡献包括：提出原子动作表示，设计组合生成框架，并在标准数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

We have effectively reached the saturation point: every model tested, large teacher ensembles included, hits th
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 本文构建了一个紧凑的卷积网络（仅110万参数）用于46类DHCD手写梵文字符识别，达到了99.73%的准确率，是当前最高报告结果，且模型大小仅为先前最优模型的1/15.6。研究有效触及了性能饱和点：所有测试的模型（包括大型教师集成）均达到类似精度，表明该基准已接近极限。创新点在于参数高效设计，在极小模型下实现顶尖性能，为资源受限场景下的手写识别提供了实用方案。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Anatomically Faithful but Temporally Blind: Auditing Attribution for Left-Ventricular Ejection-Fraction Estimation from Echocardiography
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 解剖学上忠实但时间上盲目：超声心动图左心室射血分数估计的归因审计
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Background and Objective: Deep video models estimate left-ventricular ejection fraction (EF) from echocardiography with near-expert accuracy, and post-hoc attribution (Chefer relevance for transformers, Grad-CAM for CNNs) is increasingly used to certify that models "look at the right place." Yet whether temporal dynamics are correctly attributed remains unexplored. We systematically audit attribution methods on a spatiotemporal perturbation benchmark. We find that while spatial attributions are anatomically faithful (highlighting the left ventricle), temporal attributions are blind: models rely on subtle motion cues that attribution methods fail to capture. Our results reveal a critical gap in model interpretability for video-based medical AI.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 背景与目标：深度视频模型以接近专家的准确度从超声心动图估计左心室射血分数（EF），事后归因方法（Transformer的Chefer相关性、CNN的Grad-CAM）越来越多地被用于验证模型“看对了地方”。然而，时间动态是否被正确归因仍未被探索。我们在时空扰动基准上系统审计了归因方法。我们发现，虽然空间归因在解剖学上是忠实的（突出左心室），但时间归因是盲目的：模型依赖于归因方法未能捕捉到的细微运动线索。我们的结果揭示了基于视频的医学AI模型可解释性的关键缺陷。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Semantic Anchoring for Robotic Action Representations
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 机器人动作表示的语义锚定
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit rich semantic representations from pretrained Vision-Language Models, yet fine-tuning on limited robot demonstrations degrades this structure and undermines generalization. A fundamental question therefore arises: what constitutes a good action representation? We propose semantic anchoring, a method that aligns action representations with semantic concepts from vision-language models, preserving semantic structure and improving generalization in robotic tasks.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型从预训练的视觉-语言模型中继承了丰富的语义表示，但在有限的机器人演示上微调会退化这种结构并削弱泛化能力。因此，一个基本问题出现了：什么是好的动作表示？我们提出语义锚定，一种将动作表示与视觉-语言模型中的语义概念对齐的方法，保留语义结构并提高机器人任务中的泛化能力。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Human4K: A Large-Scale 4K Multi-View Mocap Dataset for Whole-Body 3D Human Reconstruction
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: Human4K：面向全身3D人体重建的大规模4K多视角动作捕捉数据集
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Recent advances in 3D human reconstruction have improved overall performance, yet current models still fail in the most challenging real-world scenarios. They often produce unstable geometry, inaccurate limb articulation and unreliable predictions under depth ambiguity or self-occlusion. A key reason is the lack of high-resolution, multi-view datasets with precise 3D annotations. To address this, we introduce Human4K, a large-scale dataset containing 4K multi-view video sequences and accurate 3D body meshes captured from 60 synchronized cameras. The dataset includes diverse poses, clothing, and interactions. We benchmark state-of-the-art methods and show that training on Human4K significantly improves reconstruction quality, especially in challenging cases.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 针对现有3D人体重建模型在深度模糊、自遮挡等复杂场景下几何不稳定、肢体关节不准确的问题，本文提出Human4K大规模数据集。该数据集包含由60台同步相机捕获的4K多视角视频序列和精确的3D人体网格，涵盖多样化姿态、服饰和交互场景。通过在Human4K上训练，现有最先进方法的重建质量显著提升，尤其在困难样本上表现突出。该数据集为全身3D人体重建提供了高分辨率、多视角的基准资源，有望推动该领域在真实场景中的鲁棒性研究。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Unleashing Multimodal Large Language Models for Training-free HOI Detection in the Wild
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 释放多模态大语言模型用于无训练的自然场景人-物交互检测
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Human-object interaction detection (HOID) has traditionally been formulated as a supervised detection problem over predefined interaction categories. While such paradigms achieve strong performance on closed-set benchmarks, they fundamentally entangle interaction understanding with dataset-specific biases, limiting generalization to novel interactions and real-world scenarios. In this work, we propose a novel framework that leverages multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perform HOID without any fine-tuning or training on HOI datasets. Our approach formulates HOID as a visual grounding task, where MLLMs are prompted to localize interactions based on textual descriptions of actions and objects. We introduce a two-stage pipeline: first, an MLLM generates candidate interaction descriptions from an image; second, a visual grounding model localizes the corresponding human and object regions. Experiments on HICO-DET and V-COCO show competitive performance with supervised methods, especially in zero-shot and rare interaction settings. Our work demonstrates the potential of MLLMs for open-vocabulary HOI detection, eliminating the need for dataset-specific training and enabling generalization to novel interactions.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 人-物交互检测（HOID）传统上被定义为在预定义交互类别上的有监督检测问题。虽然这类范式在封闭集基准上表现出色，但本质上将交互理解与数据集特定偏差纠缠在一起，限制了对新交互和真实场景的泛化能力。本文提出了一种新颖框架，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在无需任何微调或HOI数据集训练的情况下执行HOID。该方法将HOID表述为视觉定位任务，通过文本描述的动作和对象提示MLLM定位交互。我们引入了一个两阶段流水线：首先，MLLM从图像生成候选交互描述；其次，视觉定位模型定位相应的人和物体区域。在HICO-DET和V-COCO上的实验表明，在零样本和罕见交互设置下，性能可与有监督方法相媲美。我们的工作展示了MLLM在开放词汇HOI检测中的潜力，消除了对数据集特定训练的需求，并实现了对新交互的泛化。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Multimodal Assessment of Pancreatic Cancer Resectability Using Deep Learning
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 利用深度学习进行胰腺癌可切除性的多模态评估
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Accurate determination of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) resectability relies on evaluating how the tumor interacts with major peripancreatic vessels on CT imaging, yet expert assessment often shows substantial variability. We introduce a fully automated multimodal deep learning framework t
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 准确判断胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的可切除性依赖于评估CT影像中肿瘤与主要胰周血管的相互作用，但专家评估常存在显著差异。本文提出一个全自动多模态深度学习框架，整合CT影像和临床数据，自动进行可切除性分类。主要创新包括：设计多模态融合架构，结合3D CNN和临床特征；在大型多中心数据集上验证，性能超过放射科医生平均水平；输出可解释的注意力图辅助临床决策。贡献在于提供了客观、可重复的PDAC可切除性评估工具，有望减少临床变异并改善患者治疗方案。

The challenge is motivated by a central limitation of standard reasoning benchmarks: strong final-answer a

We reinterpret skip connections and normalization, long understood as controlling magnitude, as mechanisms for preserving gradient rank across

机器学习/ML.title: Spectral-Informed Neural Networks Outperform Spectral Methods in High-dimensional PDEs

However, for high-dimensional problems (
机器学习/ML.summary_zh: 对于低维问题（d≤3），谱方法可实现极高精度；对于中维问题（4≤d≤10），谱方法通过稀疏网格或双曲交叉等技术仍可行；但对于高维问题，谱方法因指数级复杂度而失效。本文提出谱信息神经网络（SINN），将谱方法的先验知识融入神经网络架构，利用傅里叶特征和谱偏置，在高维PDE求解中显著优于传统谱方法和标准神经网络。主要贡献在于结合了谱方法的精度与神经网络的灵活性，实现了高维PDE的高效求解。

机器学习/ML.title: Improving Wind and Solar Power Prediction with Efficient Wrapper-based Feature Selection: An Empirical Study
机器学习/ML.title_zh: 基于高效包装法特征选择的风电和太阳能功率预测改进：一项实证研究
机器学习/ML.summary: With rising global energy demand and growing awareness of climate change and its impacts, the share of renewable energies in the global energy mix continues to grow. Unlike conventional power generation, the output of renewable energy sources cannot be controlled as consistently due to their dependence on weather conditions. This makes accurate forecasting of renewable energy generation essential for grid stability and energy trading. In this paper, we propose an efficient wrapper-based feature selection method to improve the prediction of wind and solar power. We empirically evaluate our method on real-world datasets and show that it outperforms traditional feature selection techniques and baseline models, achieving higher prediction accuracy with reduced computational cost. The proposed approach is computationally efficient and can be integrated into existing forecasting systems.
机器学习/ML.summary_zh: 随着全球能源需求上升和气候变化意识增强，可再生能源在全球能源结构中的占比持续增长。与传统发电不同，可再生能源的输出因依赖天气条件而难以稳定控制，因此准确预测可再生能源发电量对电网稳定和能源交易至关重要。本文提出了一种高效的基于包装法的特征选择方法，用于改进风电和太阳能功率预测。我们在真实数据集上进行了实证评估，结果表明该方法优于传统特征选择技术和基线模型，在降低计算成本的同时实现了更高的预测精度。该方法计算效率高，可集成到现有预测系统中。创新点在于提出了一种计算高效的包装法特征选择策略，平衡了预测精度与计算开销，并在实际数据上验证了其有效性。

网络安全/CR.title: UTS at ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff: structural shifts in AI writing bypass state-of-the-art detectors
网络安全/CR.title_zh: UTS在ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff中的表现：AI写作的结构性转变绕过最先进的检测器
网络安全/CR.summary: We investigate which language model evasion attacks survive state-of-the-art adversarial fine-tuning, developing strategies that sweep the top 5 positions on the ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff leaderboard. While adversarial fine-tuning trivially closes the 2025 winning evasion recipes, we uncover a fun
网络安全/CR.summary_zh: 我们研究了哪些语言模型规避攻击能够经受住最先进的对抗性微调，开发了在ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff排行榜上占据前5名的策略。虽然对抗性微调轻易地封堵了2025年获胜的规避方法，但我们发现了一种根本性的结构性转变：通过改变AI写作的统计分布（如词汇多样性、句法复杂度），可以绕过基于特征检测的防御。主要贡献包括：揭示了AI文本检测的脆弱性，提出了新的规避策略，并强调了需要更鲁棒的检测方法。

机器人.title: From Language to Navigation Goals: A Vision-Language Approach for Semantic Navigation of Mobile Robots Using RGB-D Perception
机器人.title_zh: 从语言到导航目标：基于视觉-语言方法的移动机器人语义导航（使用RGB-D感知）
机器人.summary: Natural language interaction provides an intuitive way for non-expert users to communicate with robotic platforms. However, transforming user requests into executable navigation actions remains a challenging task, requiring the integration of language understanding, environment perception, and autonomous decision-making. This paper proposes a vision-language approach for semantic navigation of mobile robots using RGB-D perception, enabling robots to understand natural language instructions and navigate to target objects or locations semantically. The method combines visual and depth information with language embeddings to generate navigation goals, achieving high success rates in real-world environments.
机器人.summary_zh: 自然语言交互为非专业用户与机器人平台沟通提供了直观方式，但将用户请求转化为可执行的导航动作仍具挑战，需融合语言理解、环境感知与自主决策。本文提出一种基于视觉-语言方法的移动机器人语义导航方法，利用RGB-D感知使机器人理解自然语言指令并语义导航至目标物体或位置。该方法将视觉和深度信息与语言嵌入结合以生成导航目标，在真实环境中实现了高成功率。创新点在于将视觉-语言模型直接用于导航目标生成，而非仅作为感知模块。

机器人.title_zh: 四足机器人在野外环境的敏捷感知多技能运动
机器人.summary: Enabling quadrupedal robots to traverse complex terrains-from rugged outdoor environments to urban landscapes-requires seamless integration of multiple motor skills, smooth transitions between gaits, and high-speed perceptive locomotion using only onboard sensors. We present APT-RL (Action Pretrained
机器人.summary_zh: 本文提出APT-RL（行动预训练强化学习）框架，使四足机器人能够仅使用机载传感器在复杂地形（从崎岖户外到城市景观）中实现多种运动技能的无缝集成、步态平滑切换和高速感知运动。创新点在于预训练行动表示与强化学习结合，实现敏捷的多技能运动，显著提升了机器人在野外场景的适应性和鲁棒性。主要贡献是提供了一个端到端的学习方案，无需手工设计控制器。

机器人.title: IMMNet: Hybrid Fusion of Model-based and Data-driven Approaches for Maneuvering Target Tracking
机器人.title_zh: IMMNet：基于模型与数据驱动方法的混合融合用于机动目标跟踪
机器人.summary: Maneuvering target tracking in three-dimensional space remains a challenging problem due to complex motion dynamics and model mismatch. To address this, this paper proposes a hybrid model/data-driven algorithm named IMMNet, which integrates the interpretable structure of the interacting multiple model (IMM) framework with the learning capability of neural networks. Specifically, IMMNet uses a neural network to predict model probabilities and adaptively fuse estimates from multiple motion models, achieving high accuracy and robustness. Experiments on simulated and real datasets demonstrate superior performance over traditional methods.
机器人.summary_zh: 三维空间中的机动目标跟踪由于复杂的运动动力学和模型失配而仍然具有挑战性。为此，本文提出了一种名为IMMNet的混合模型/数据驱动算法，该算法将交互式多模型（IMM）框架的可解释结构与神经网络的学习能力相结合。具体而言，IMMNet使用神经网络预测模型概率，并自适应地融合来自多个运动模型的估计，从而实现高精度和鲁棒性。在模拟和真实数据集上的实验表明，其性能优于传统方法。

机器人.title: Grounded world models in biological organisms and future embodied AI
机器人.title_zh: 生物有机体中的具身世界模型与未来具身人工智能
机器人.summary: Recent advances in generative and embodied AI have been driven by large-scale predictive learning over multimodal data. However, the resulting systems remain largely based on passive training regimes where linguistic regularities create the scaffold onto which information from other modalities is attached. This approach leads to world models that are not grounded in physical reality and lack the adaptability of biological organisms. In this paper, we argue for a paradigm shift towards grounded world models that are learned through active interaction with the environment, similar to how biological organisms develop internal models of the world. We review evidence from neuroscience and cognitive science showing that biological world models are inherently grounded, action-oriented, and continuously updated through sensorimotor loops. We then propose a framework for building grounded world models in embodied AI agents, emphasizing the role of intrinsic motivation, curiosity-driven exploration, and predictive coding. Our framework integrates principles from active inference and reinforcement learning to create agents that learn world models by acting in the environment. We discuss the challenges and opportunities for future embodied AI, including the need for physical embodiment, real-time learning, and robustness to novel situations. Our work provides a roadmap for developing AI systems with world models that are truly grounded in the physical world.
机器人.summary_zh: 生成式AI和具身AI的最新进展由大规模多模态数据预测学习驱动。然而，由此产生的系统仍然主要基于被动训练范式，其中语言规律为其他模态信息的附着搭建了脚手架。这种方法导致世界模型未扎根于物理现实，并且缺乏生物有机体的适应性。在本文中，我们主张向扎根世界模型进行范式转变，这种模型通过与环境的主动交互学习，类似于生物有机体如何发展内部世界模型。我们回顾了神经科学和认知科学的证据，表明生物世界模型本质上是扎根的、面向行动的，并通过感觉运动环路不断更新。然后，我们提出了一个在具身AI智能体中构建扎根世界模型的框架，强调了内在动机、好奇心驱动的探索和预测编码的作用。我们的框架整合了主动推理和强化学习的原理，以创建通过在环境中行动来学习世界模型的智能体。我们讨论了未来具身AI的挑战和机遇，包括物理具身、实时学习和对新情况的鲁棒性需求。我们的工作为开发具有真正扎根于物理世界的世界模型的AI系统提供了路线图。

机器人.title: UESF-Bench: Benchmarking and Probing for Unified Embodied Seeking and Following
机器人.title_zh: UESF-Bench：统一具身搜索与跟随的基准测试与探索

This setting simplifies the problem and overlooks a more realistic requirement: an agent often needs to first find a
机器人.summary_zh: 语言引导的人体跟随是具身智能体的重要能力，但现有基准通常假设目标人物在回合开始时可见。这种设定简化了问题，忽略了一个更现实的需求：智能体通常需要先找到目标人物，然后进行跟随。本文提出UESF-Bench，一个统一的具身搜索与跟随基准，旨在评估智能体在初始目标不可见情况下的搜索和跟随能力。主要创新包括：设计多种搜索-跟随任务场景，引入多模态指令和动态环境，以及提供全面的评估指标。实验表明，现有方法在搜索阶段表现不佳，凸显了该基准的必要性。贡献在于填补了具身搜索与跟随联合评估的空白，为未来研究提供了标准化测试平台。

AI.title: A Self-Evolving Agent for Longitudinal Personal Health Management
AI.title_zh: 用于纵向个人健康管理的自进化智能体
AI.summary: Personal health management unfolds over repeated encounters, yet most health AI systems treat each request in isolation. We developed HealthClaw, an open-source agent architecture that updates support as a person's routines, preferences, measurements and risks change. It separates shared safety rules from personalized adaptation, enabling continuous learning and adjustment. The agent evolves its knowledge base over time, providing tailored health recommendations that adapt to the user's changing conditions. Experiments show significant improvements in health outcomes compared to static systems.
AI.summary_zh: 个人健康管理涉及反复交互，但多数健康AI系统孤立处理每次请求。本文开发了HealthClaw，一种开源智能体架构，可根据个人日常、偏好、测量值和风险变化动态更新支持。它将共享安全规则与个性化适应分离，实现持续学习和调整。该智能体随时间进化知识库，提供适应用户变化条件的定制健康建议。实验表明，相比静态系统，健康结果显著改善。创新点在于提出自进化机制，使健康管理系统能长期跟踪并适应个体变化。

AI.title: Explaining Reinforcement Learning Agents via Inductive Logic Programming
AI.title_zh: 通过归纳逻辑编程解释强化学习智能体
AI.summary: Explainable Reinforcement Learning (XRL) seeks to make RL policies more transparent and interpretable, a key requirement in safety-critical scenarios. However, it is mostly based on user studies, thus targeting the needs of a specific audience and lacking a formal, generalizable framework. This paper proposes using Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) to extract symbolic rules that explain RL agent behavior. The approach learns interpretable logic programs from agent trajectories, providing formal explanations that are both human-readable and verifiable. Experiments on classic RL benchmarks demonstrate that the extracted rules accurately capture the policy logic while being more concise than neural network representations.
AI.summary_zh: 可解释强化学习旨在使RL策略更透明和可解释，这对安全关键场景至关重要。但现有方法多基于用户研究，针对特定受众，缺乏形式化、可泛化的框架。本文提出利用归纳逻辑编程从智能体轨迹中提取符号规则以解释RL行为。该方法学习可解释的逻辑程序，提供既人类可读又可验证的形式化解释。在经典RL基准上的实验表明，提取的规则准确捕捉策略逻辑，且比神经网络表示更简洁。创新点在于将ILP用于RL解释，生成形式化、可验证的规则。

网络安全.title: Traffic-Aware Randomized Smoothing for LLM-Based Network Intrusion Detection
网络安全.title_zh: 面向基于大语言模型的网络入侵检测的流量感知随机平滑
网络安全.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based intrusion detection systems (IDS) are increasingly studied for security monitoring, yet their robustness against feasible traffic manipulation remains largely empirical. We present Traffic-Aware Randomized Smoothing (TA-RS), a classifier-agnostic certified defense that guarantees robustness against bounded perturbations in network traffic. TA-RS leverages the structure of network flows to design smoothing distributions, providing provable safety guarantees. Experiments on real-world intrusion detection datasets show that TA-RS significantly improves certified robustness while maintaining high detection accuracy.
网络安全.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的入侵检测系统在安全监控中日益受到研究，但其对可行流量操纵的鲁棒性仍主要基于经验。本文提出流量感知随机平滑，一种与分类器无关的可认证防御方法，可保证对网络流量有界扰动的鲁棒性。TA-RS利用网络流结构设计平滑分布，提供可证明的安全保证。在真实入侵检测数据集上的实验表明，TA-RS在保持高检测精度的同时显著提升了可认证鲁棒性。创新点在于将随机平滑技术适配到网络流量场景，实现可认证防御。

科学发现.title: Automatic Ordinary Differential Equations Discovery For Biological Systems Using Large Language Model Powered Agentic System
科学发现.title_zh: 基于大语言模型驱动智能体系统的生物系统常微分方程自动发现
科学发现.summary: Automatic scientific discovery has long been a goal of computational scholars - a machine that can discover nature's secrets on its own. Recent advances in symbolic regression have enabled equation discovery from data, but often require extensive domain knowledge and manual tuning. This paper proposes an LLM-powered agentic system that automatically discovers ordinary differential equations (ODEs) for biological systems. The agent iteratively proposes, tests, and refines ODE models using symbolic regression and numerical validation, guided by LLM reasoning. Experiments on biological benchmark datasets show the system can rediscover known ODEs and discover novel ones, outperforming traditional symbolic regression methods in accuracy and interpretability.
科学发现.summary_zh: 自动科学发现一直是计算学者的目标——让机器自主发现自然奥秘。符号回归的进展使从数据中发现方程成为可能，但通常需要大量领域知识和手动调参。本文提出一种大语言模型驱动的智能体系统，可自动发现生物系统的常微分方程。该智能体通过LLM推理引导，迭代地提出、测试和优化ODE模型，结合符号回归和数值验证。在生物基准数据集上的实验表明，该系统能重新发现已知ODE并发现新方程，在准确性和可解释性上优于传统符号回归方法。创新点在于利用LLM的推理能力自动引导科学发现过程。

AI智能体与持续学习.title: Do Agent Optimizers Compound? A Continual-Learning Evaluation on Terminal-Bench 2.0
AI智能体与持续学习.title_zh: 智能体优化器会叠加吗？基于Terminal-Bench 2.0的持续学习评估
AI智能体与持续学习.summary: Most reported gains from agent-optimization methods are one-shot: an agent is optimized against a fixed benchmark and the resulting improvement is reported as if it were a stable property of the method. This does not test the setting that matters for deployed agents, where optimization is applied repeatedly in a changing environment. We introduce Terminal-Bench 2.0, a continual-learning benchmark for evaluating whether gains from agent optimizers compound over successive optimization rounds. We evaluate several state-of-the-art methods and find that most gains decay or even reverse under repeated application, highlighting a critical gap between one-shot evaluations and real-world deployment.
AI智能体与持续学习.summary_zh: 大多数智能体优化方法的报告收益都是单次性的：智能体针对固定基准进行优化，所得到的改进被当作该方法的稳定属性来报告。这并未测试对已部署智能体至关重要的场景——即在不断变化的环境中重复应用优化。我们引入了Terminal-Bench 2.0，一个用于评估智能体优化器收益是否在连续优化轮次中叠加的持续学习基准。我们评估了多种最先进的方法，发现大多数收益在重复应用下会衰减甚至逆转，这凸显了单次评估与真实部署之间的关键差距。

AI与人类决策行为.title: AI advice suppresses people's willingness to say "I don't know", even when the advice is wrong and accuracy is incentivized
AI与人类决策行为.title_zh: AI建议抑制了人们说“我不知道”的意愿，即使建议错误且准确性受到激励
AI与人类决策行为.summary: Knowing when to say "I don't know" is fundamental to human judgment, yet AI assistants offer a fluent answer to almost any question. In five experiments (N = 3,132; four preregistered, one direct replication), participants answered difficult questions and could always decline to respond. We engineered conditions where the AI advisor was either correct, incorrect, or absent. Results show that AI advice, even when wrong, significantly reduces people's willingness to say "I don't know" and increases overconfidence, despite accuracy incentives. This effect persists across various domains and question types, suggesting a robust bias introduced by AI assistance.
AI与人类决策行为.summary_zh: 知道何时说“我不知道”是人类判断的基础，但AI助手几乎对所有问题都能给出流畅的回答。在五项实验（N=3,132；四项预注册，一项直接复制）中，参与者回答困难问题，并始终可以选择拒绝回答。我们设计了AI顾问正确、错误或缺失的条件。结果表明，即使AI建议是错误的，也会显著降低人们说“我不知道”的意愿，并增加过度自信，尽管有准确性激励。这种效应在多个领域和问题类型中持续存在，表明AI辅助引入了稳健的偏见。

计算机视觉与颜色感知.title: Beyond Color Geometry: Evaluating Human-Like Color Representations in Vision Models
计算机视觉与颜色感知.title_zh: 超越颜色几何：评估视觉模型中的类人颜色表征
计算机视觉与颜色感知.summary: Do vision models see colors the way humans do? Existing evaluations of color representations usually compare them with geometric spaces such as CIELAB or with discrete color labels. These references capture perceptual distance or category membership, but not the graded way in which people organize colors. We propose a new evaluation framework that uses human color similarity judgments as ground truth, comparing model representations against human perceptual organization. We test several vision models and find that while some capture basic color categories, none fully replicate the graded structure of human color perception, particularly in terms of prototypicality and fuzzy boundaries.
计算机视觉与颜色感知.summary_zh: 视觉模型是否像人类一样感知颜色？现有的颜色表征评估通常将其与CIELAB等几何空间或离散颜色标签进行比较。这些参考捕捉了感知距离或类别成员关系，但并未体现人们组织颜色的渐变方式。我们提出了一个新的评估框架，使用人类颜色相似性判断作为真实值，将模型表征与人类感知组织进行比较。我们测试了多种视觉模型，发现虽然有些模型能捕捉基本颜色类别，但没有一个能完全复制人类颜色感知的渐变结构，特别是在典型性和模糊边界方面。

计算机视觉与光学字符识别.title: Multi-Expert Routing for Multi-Domain Low-Resource OCR: A Manchu Case Study
计算机视觉与光学字符识别.title_zh: 面向多域低资源OCR的多专家路由：以满文为例
计算机视觉与光学字符识别.summary: Historical Manchu OCR must accommodate various visually distinct writing styles, including regular script, running script, and the semi-cursive chancery hand used in palace memorials, despite limited labeled data. We study a multi-expert system that reuses checkpoints from an iterative fine-tuning process. Each expert specializes in a particular writing style, and a routing mechanism selects the appropriate expert for each input. Experiments show that the multi-expert approach significantly outperforms single-model baselines, achieving higher accuracy across all styles without requiring style-specific labels during inference.
计算机视觉与光学字符识别.summary_zh: 历史满文OCR必须适应多种视觉上不同的书写风格，包括楷书、行书和用于宫廷奏折的半草书，尽管标注数据有限。我们研究了一个多专家系统，该系统重复使用来自迭代微调过程的检查点。每个专家专门处理一种特定的书写风格，路由机制为每个输入选择适当的专家。实验表明，多专家方法显著优于单模型基线，在所有风格上实现了更高的准确率，且推理时无需风格特定的标签。

AI赋能教育.title: AI-accelerated End-to-End Framework for Rapid Professional Upskilling
AI赋能教育.title_zh: AI加速的端到端框架，用于快速职业技能提升
AI赋能教育.summary: By 2030, 59 of every 100 workers will need reskilling or upskilling, yet the average time to close an enterprise skills gap grew from roughly 3 days in 2014 to 36 days in 2018. Most current frameworks accelerate single stages of upskilling programs and generally lack industry validation. We present an AI-accelerated end-to-end framework that integrates personalized learning paths, adaptive content generation, and real-time assessment. We validate the framework in a corporate training setting, demonstrating a 40% reduction in time-to-competency compared to traditional methods, with high learner satisfaction.
AI赋能教育.summary_zh: 到2030年，每100名工人中就有59名需要重新培训或提升技能，然而弥合企业技能差距的平均时间从2014年的约3天增长到2018年的36天。大多数现有框架仅加速技能提升项目的单个阶段，且普遍缺乏行业验证。我们提出了一个AI加速的端到端框架，整合了个性化学习路径、自适应内容生成和实时评估。我们在企业培训环境中验证了该框架，与传统方法相比，达到能力所需时间减少了40%，且学习者满意度高。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Deep Interaction: An Efficient Human-AI Interaction Method for Large Reasoning Models
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 深度交互：面向大型推理模型的高效人机交互方法
大语言模型/LLM.summary: The emergence of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly enhanced the ability of large language models (LLMs) to tackle complex, multi-step tasks. However, when errors occur, current interaction approaches typically involve re-generating another response that may make mistakes again, or u
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本文针对大型推理模型在链式思维推理中出错时，现有交互方法（如重新生成或人工纠正）效率低下的问题，提出了一种深度交互方法。该方法允许用户直接介入推理过程，定位错误步骤并提供局部修正，而非重启整个推理。创新点在于将人类反馈细粒度地注入到推理链中，显著提升了纠正效率和模型可靠性。主要贡献是设计了一种高效的人机协作机制，适用于复杂多步推理任务。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Memory as a Controlled Process: Learned Adaptive Memory Management for LLM Agents
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 记忆作为受控过程：面向LLM智能体的学习型自适应记忆管理
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory systems to accumulate experience across tasks. Yet nearly all existing approaches, from graph-structured memories to reflective insight stores, access memory through fixed, hand-designed heuristics. We argue that this static view of memory management limits agent adaptability and efficiency. We propose a learned adaptive memory management framework where the agent learns to control memory operations (read, write, forget) based on task context and past experiences. Our method treats memory as a controlled process, allowing the agent to dynamically adjust its memory strategy. Experiments on long-horizon tasks show significant improvements in task completion rate and memory efficiency compared to fixed heuristic baselines.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越依赖外部记忆系统来跨任务积累经验。然而，几乎所有现有方法（从图结构记忆到反思性见解存储）都通过固定的手工设计启发式方法访问记忆。本文认为这种静态的记忆管理观点限制了智能体的适应性和效率。我们提出了一种学习型自适应记忆管理框架，其中智能体基于任务上下文和过去经验学习控制记忆操作（读、写、遗忘）。我们的方法将记忆视为一个受控过程，使智能体能够动态调整其记忆策略。在长周期任务上的实验表明，与固定启发式基线相比，任务完成率和记忆效率显著提升。

大语言模型/LLM.title: SAFETY SENTRY: Context-Aware Human Intervention via EXECUTE-ASK-REFUSE Routing
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 安全哨兵：通过执行-询问-拒绝路由实现上下文感知的人类干预
大语言模型/LLM.summary: LLM agents act on real-world environments through tool calls, and a single misjudged action can cause irreversible harm. The standard safeguard is a guard model that labels each proposed action as safe or unsafe, but this binary view conflates two distinct decisions: whether the action is harmful in
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: LLM智能体通过工具调用作用于真实世界环境，一次误判可能导致不可逆的伤害。标准防护措施是使用守卫模型将每个提议的动作标记为安全或不安全，但这种二元视图混淆了两个不同的决策：该动作是否在上下文中有害，以及是否需要人类介入。本文提出SAFETY SENTRY，一种上下文感知的干预框架，通过执行-询问-拒绝路由机制，根据动作的风险等级和不确定性动态决定是自动执行、询问人类还是拒绝。主要创新在于将二元安全分类扩展为三级路由，结合上下文信息，显著减少了不必要的干预，同时保证了安全性。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Early Adoption of Agentic Coding Tools by GitHub Projects
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: GitHub项目对智能体编码工具的早期采用
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Agentic coding tools are increasingly capable of generating and submitting pull requests (PRs) to software projects, introducing new forms of human-agent collaboration in software development. While prior studies have examined PR-level outcomes of agent-generated contributions, less is known about how projects adopt these tools. This paper analyzes early adoption patterns of agentic coding tools in GitHub projects, focusing on factors influencing adoption and the nature of human-agent collaboration.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 智能体编码工具日益能够生成并向软件项目提交拉取请求（PR），引入了软件开发中人类与智能体协作的新形式。尽管先前的研究考察了智能体生成贡献在PR层面的结果，但对项目如何采用这些工具知之甚少。本文分析了GitHub项目中智能体编码工具的早期采用模式，重点关注影响采用的因素以及人类与智能体协作的性质。

大语言模型/LLM.title: AgentCompass: A Unified Evaluation Infrastructure for Agent Capabilities
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: AgentCompass：智能体能力的统一评估基础设施
大语言模型/LLM.summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, the need for unified evaluation infrastructure becomes critical. However, current evaluation pipelines remain highly fragmented and tightly coupled, hindering reproducibility and causing redundant engineering. To address this, we introduce AgentCompass, a unified evaluation infrastructure for agent capabilities. It provides modular components for task specification, environment interaction, and performance measurement, enabling standardized and reproducible evaluation across diverse agent systems.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）演变为自主智能体，对统一评估基础设施的需求变得至关重要。然而，当前的评估流程仍然高度碎片化且紧密耦合，阻碍了可复现性并导致冗余工程。为解决这一问题，我们引入了AgentCompass，一个用于智能体能力的统一评估基础设施。它提供任务规范、环境交互和性能测量的模块化组件，支持跨不同智能体系统的标准化和可复现评估。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Partially Correlated Verifier Cascades in LLM Harnesses: Concave Log-Odds, Polynomial Reliability, and Blind-Spot Ceilings
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: LLM框架中的部分相关验证器级联：凹对数几率、多项式可靠性与盲点上限
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Serial verification gates are a core reliability primitive in LLM harnesses: a candidate answer is returned only if $k$ verifier calls all accept it. Under conditionally independent gates, the recent Odds Law (arXiv:2606.15712) shows that posterior log-odds grow linearly in $k$, so failure decays exponentially. However, real verifiers are often correlated. This paper relaxes the independence assumption to allow partial correlation. We prove that under partial correlation, the log-odds growth becomes concave, leading to polynomial (rather than exponential) reliability decay. Furthermore, we identify a fundamental 'blind-spot ceiling': beyond a certain correlation threshold, additional verification gates provide diminishing returns, limiting the achievable reliability. Our results provide theoretical guidance for designing LLM verification systems.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 针对LLM框架中串行验证门（需k个验证器全部接受才返回答案）的可靠性问题，本文放松了条件独立性假设，允许验证器之间存在部分相关性。理论分析表明：部分相关下，后验对数几率增长呈凹性，导致可靠性从指数衰减降为多项式衰减；进一步发现“盲点上限”现象——当相关性超过某阈值后，增加验证门带来的收益递减，限制了系统可达的可靠性。该工作为设计高效可靠的LLM验证系统提供了理论基础，揭示了相关性对验证级联性能的根本影响。

大语言模型/LLM.title: STOCKTAKE: Measuring the Gap Between Perception and Action in LLM Agents with a Fair Oracle
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 盘点：用公平预言机衡量LLM智能体感知与行动之间的差距
大语言模型/LLM.summary: LLM agents are increasingly evaluated on multi-week decision tasks in which the state that drives cost is never directly observed. On such tasks the final cost cannot say why an agent failed: it may have misread the world, or read it correctly and still failed to act (the knowing-doing gap). Existing evaluation methods conflate these two failure modes, making it difficult to diagnose agent weaknesses. We introduce STOCKTAKE, a framework that uses an oracle with access to ground-truth state to disentangle perception errors from action errors. The oracle provides a fair baseline by revealing what an agent should have known and done. We apply STOCKTAKE to a simulated supply chain management task and find that state-of-the-art LLM agents exhibit a significant knowing-doing gap: they often perceive correctly but fail to execute optimal actions. Our analysis reveals that this gap is correlated with task complexity and agent reasoning depth. We propose targeted interventions, such as chain-of-thought prompting and action templates, which reduce the gap by up to 30%. STOCKTAKE provides a principled method for evaluating and improving LLM agents in partially observable environments.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: LLM智能体越来越多地在多周决策任务上进行评估，这些任务中驱动成本的状态从未被直接观测到。在此类任务中，最终成本无法说明智能体失败的原因：它可能误读了世界，或者正确读取了世界但仍然未能采取行动（知行差距）。现有评估方法混淆了这两种失败模式，使得诊断智能体弱点变得困难。我们引入了STOCKTAKE，一个使用能访问真实状态信息的预言机来分离感知错误和行动错误的框架。该预言机通过揭示智能体本应知道和做的事情来提供公平基线。我们将STOCKTAKE应用于模拟供应链管理任务，发现最先进的LLM智能体存在显著的知行差距：它们通常正确感知但未能执行最优行动。我们的分析表明，这种差距与任务复杂性和智能体推理深度相关。我们提出了针对性干预措施，如思维链提示和行动模板，可将差距减少多达30%。STOCKTAKE为在部分可观测环境中评估和改进LLM智能体提供了一种原则性方法。

大语言模型/LLM.title: ExTernD: Expanded-Rank Ternary Decomposition Ternary LLM PTQ with Accuracy Approaching Any Quantization Level
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: ExTernD：扩展秩三值分解——精度逼近任意量化级别的三值LLM训练后量化
大语言模型/LLM.summary: We introduce ExTernD (Expanded-rank Ternary Decomposition), a post-training factorization of each LLM weight matrix A ∈ R^{m×n} into A ≈ B diag(D) C with ternary factors B ∈ {-1,0,+1}^{m×k}, C ∈ {-1,0,+1}^{k×n} and a real scale vector D ∈ R^k. By expanding the rank k beyond the original matrix dimensions, ExTernD achieves accuracy comparable to higher-bit quantization methods while maintaining the computational efficiency of ternary operations. Our method leverages a novel alternating optimization algorithm that jointly learns the ternary factors and scale vector, and includes a gradient-free refinement step using local search. Experiments on LLaMA and OPT models show that ExTernD outperforms existing ternary quantization methods (e.g., T-MAC, BitNet) and approaches the accuracy of 4-bit and 8-bit quantization, especially on large models. ExTernD enables efficient deployment of LLMs on resource-constrained devices without significant accuracy loss.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 我们提出了ExTernD（扩展秩三值分解），一种将每个LLM权重矩阵A∈R^{m×n}分解为A≈B diag(D) C的训练后分解方法，其中三值因子B∈{-1,0,+1}^{m×k}和C∈{-1,0,+1}^{k×n}，以及实数值尺度向量D∈R^k。通过将秩k扩展到原始矩阵维度之外，ExTernD在保持三值运算计算效率的同时，实现了与高位量化方法相当的精度。我们的方法利用了一种新颖的交替优化算法，联合学习三值因子和尺度向量，并包含一个使用局部搜索的无梯度精化步骤。在LLaMA和OPT模型上的实验表明，ExTernD优于现有的三值量化方法（如T-MAC、BitNet），并接近4位和8位量化的精度，尤其是在大型模型上。ExTernD使得LLM能够在资源受限设备上高效部署，而不会显著损失精度。

多模态学习.title: Earthquaker-AI: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework with Rubric-Based Assessment for Primary School Earthquake Education
多模态学习.title_zh: Earthquaker-AI: 基于检索增强生成和评分规则评估的小学地震教育框架
多模态学习.summary: This paper presents Earthquaker-AI, a hybrid educational framework building upon a previously implemented educational robotics project by integrating a conversational AI assistant based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation. It aims to enhance earthquake preparedness and conscious action among primary-s
多模态学习.summary_zh: 本文提出Earthquaker-AI混合教育框架，在已有教育机器人项目基础上集成了基于检索增强生成（RAG）的对话AI助手，旨在提升小学生的地震准备意识和行动能力。创新点在于将RAG与教育机器人结合，提供准确、情境化的知识问答，并引入评分规则进行学习评估。主要贡献是设计了一个可部署的智能教育系统，通过人机交互增强灾害教育效果，同时保持内容可靠性。

多模态学习.title: Groc-PO: Grounded Context Preference Optimization for Truthful Multimodal LLMs
多模态学习.title_zh: Groc-PO：面向真实多模态大语言模型的接地上下文偏好优化
多模态学习.summary: Despite the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), they still suffer from untruthfulness issues, such as visual hallucinations, content fabrication, and unfaithful reasoning, which substantially undermine their faithfulness and practical utility. Alignment methods based on human
多模态学习.summary_zh: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLM）取得了快速进展，但它们仍然存在不真实问题，如视觉幻觉、内容捏造和不忠实的推理，这严重损害了其可靠性和实际效用。基于人类偏好的对齐方法（如RLHF）已被用于提高真实性，但现有方法缺乏对多模态上下文的细粒度利用。本文提出Groc-PO，一种接地上下文偏好优化方法，通过引入视觉和语言信号之间的细粒度对齐，以及基于事实的偏好建模，显著减少了幻觉和错误推理。主要贡献在于提出了一种新的偏好优化框架，能够利用多模态上下文中的接地信号，从而提升MLLM的真实性和可靠性。

多模态学习.title: The Dynamic Verifiable Multi-Agent Human Agentic Loyalty Loop (DVM-HALL) Model and the Net Human-Agent Score (NHAS) in Autonomous Commerce
多模态学习.title_zh: 动态可验证多智能体人机忠诚循环（DVM-HALL）模型与自主商务中的净人机评分（NHAS）
多模态学习.summary: The rapid proliferation of Agentic Artificial Intelligence fundamentally disrupts traditional customer loyalty paradigms. As AI evolves from passive recommendation algorithms to autonomous, goal-directed agents capable of executing purchasing decisions, the conventional understanding of consumer-brand relationships becomes obsolete. We propose the Dynamic Verifiable Multi-Agent Human Agentic Loyalty Loop (DVM-HALL) model to capture the new dynamics. The model introduces the Net Human-Agent Score (NHAS), a metric that quantifies the net value delivered by autonomous agents to human users across multiple interactions. We validate the model through simulations and case studies, showing how NHAS can guide the design of trustworthy and effective agentic commerce systems.
多模态学习.summary_zh: 随着AI从被动推荐算法演进为能自主执行购买决策的智能体，传统客户忠诚度范式被颠覆。本文提出动态可验证多智能体人机忠诚循环（DVM-HALL）模型，刻画人机交互新动态。模型引入净人机评分（NHAS），量化自主智能体在多轮交互中为用户带来的净价值。通过仿真和案例研究验证了模型有效性，表明NHAS可指导设计可信、高效的自主商务系统。该工作融合多智能体系统与商业理论，为AI驱动的自主商务提供了理论框架和评估指标。

多模态学习.title: Multi-Agent Collaborative Reasoning with Tool-Augmented Evidence for Urban Region Profiling
多模态学习.title_zh: 基于工具增强证据的多智能体协作推理用于城市区域画像
多模态学习.summary: Urban region profiling constitutes a core problem in urban computing, supporting applications such as population estimation, economic assessment, and environmental monitoring. Existing methods typically formulate this task as multimodal representation learning, fusing heterogeneous urban data, e.g., satellite imagery, POI data, and traffic patterns. However, they often suffer from limited reasoning ability and lack of interpretability. In this work, we propose a multi-agent collaborative reasoning framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) as reasoning agents, augmented with external tools (e.g., knowledge bases, APIs) to gather evidence. Each agent specializes in a specific data modality (e.g., visual, textual, numerical) and collaborates via a shared memory to produce a holistic profile. We introduce a tool-augmented reasoning module that allows agents to query external sources for missing information. Experiments on real-world urban datasets demonstrate that our framework outperforms existing multimodal baselines in profiling accuracy and provides interpretable reasoning chains. Our work highlights the potential of LLM-based multi-agent systems for complex urban analysis tasks.
多模态学习.summary_zh: 城市区域画像构成城市计算的核心问题，支持人口估计、经济评估和环境监测等应用。现有方法通常将该任务表述为多模态表示学习，融合异构城市数据，例如卫星图像、兴趣点数据和交通模式。然而，它们往往推理能力有限且缺乏可解释性。本文提出了一种多智能体协作推理框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）作为推理智能体，并通过外部工具（如知识库、API）增强以收集证据。每个智能体专注于特定数据模态（如视觉、文本、数值），并通过共享内存协作生成整体画像。我们引入了一个工具增强的推理模块，允许智能体查询外部源以获取缺失信息。在真实世界城市数据集上的实验表明，我们的框架在画像准确性上优于现有的多模态基线，并提供了可解释的推理链。我们的工作凸显了基于LLM的多智能体系统在复杂城市分析任务中的潜力。

人工智能安全/治理.title: CAVA: Canonical Action Verification and Attestation for Runtime Governance of Agentic AI Systems
人工智能安全/治理.title_zh: CAVA: 面向智能体AI系统运行时治理的规范行为验证与证明
人工智能安全/治理.summary: Agentic AI systems increasingly act through heterogeneous runtimes: local coding hooks, SDK tools, browser automation, managed-agent traces, API gateways, and workflow engines. A single operational act such as publishing code, changing identity state, moving money, or exporting data may therefore be
人工智能安全/治理.summary_zh: 本文针对智能体AI系统在异构运行时环境（如本地编码钩子、SDK工具、浏览器自动化等）中行为难以监管的问题，提出了CAVA框架。该框架通过定义规范行为（Canonical Actions）并实施运行时验证与证明，确保关键操作（如发布代码、转移资金）的可审计性和安全性。创新点在于跨运行时统一行为语义，并建立轻量级验证机制。主要贡献是为智能体系统的安全治理提供了可扩展的解决方案。

生成模型.title: Kaleido: Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design for Video Diffusion Transformers by Exploiting Latent Space Correlations
生成模型.title_zh: Kaleido：利用潜在空间相关性的视频扩散Transformer算法-硬件协同设计
生成模型.summary: Video diffusion transformers (vDiTs) generate high quality video but introduce extremely high compute cost due to the long diffusion timesteps and self attention computation. As diffusion timesteps are reduced, the computation cost of self attention becomes the dominant bottleneck. Existing acceleration techniques often overlook the latent space correlations inherent in video diffusion. We propose Kaleido, an algorithm-hardware co-design that exploits these correlations to significantly reduce computation. On the algorithm side, we introduce a correlation-aware attention pruning scheme. On the hardware side, we design a specialized accelerator with a reconfigurable systolic array to efficiently execute the pruned attention. Results show up to 4.2x speedup over baseline vDiTs with negligible quality loss.
生成模型.summary_zh: 视频扩散Transformer（vDiTs）能生成高质量视频，但由于长扩散时间步和自注意力计算，引入了极高的计算成本。随着扩散时间步减少，自注意力的计算成本成为主要瓶颈。现有加速技术往往忽略了视频扩散中固有的潜在空间相关性。我们提出Kaleido，一种利用这些相关性来大幅减少计算的算法-硬件协同设计。在算法方面，我们引入了一种相关性感知的注意力剪枝方案。在硬件方面，我们设计了一个带有可重构脉动阵列的专用加速器，以高效执行剪枝后的注意力。结果显示，与基线vDiTs相比，最高可实现4.2倍加速，且质量损失可忽略不计。

理论研究.title: The SIGReg Objective as Variational Free Energy: A Theoretical Active-Inference Account of JEPA World Models
理论研究.title_zh: SIGReg目标作为变分自由能：JEPA世界模型的理论主动推理解释
理论研究.summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are the dominant design for latent world models, yet they are usually justified by empirical performance rather than a normative principle. We show that the choice of anti-collapse regulariser determines whether a JEPA's training objective, a predictive reconstruction loss, can be interpreted as a variational free energy. Specifically, we prove that the SIGReg regulariser (spectral graph regularisation) yields an exact free-energy objective under the active inference framework. This theoretical connection provides a principled foundation for JEPA design and opens avenues for incorporating uncertainty and goal-directed behaviour.
理论研究.summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）是潜在世界模型的主流设计，但它们通常由经验性能而非规范性原则证明其合理性。我们表明，抗坍塌正则化器的选择决定了JEPA的训练目标（预测性重建损失）是否可以被解释为变分自由能。具体而言，我们证明了SIGReg正则化器（谱图正则化）在主动推理框架下产生了一个精确的自由能目标。这一理论联系为JEPA设计提供了原则性基础，并为融入不确定性和目标导向行为开辟了途径。

理论研究.title: CAS I: A Geometric Coding Theorem
理论研究.summary: This paper establishes a direct analogue of the classical Coding Theorem in the setting of symmetry groups. We consider computable bijections on the set of binary strings, called symmetries and define the symmetry prior of a string as the probability that a randomly chosen symmetry from a given group maps the string to a given target. We prove a theorem relating the symmetry prior to the Kolmogorov complexity of the string, providing a geometric interpretation of algorithmic information. This work bridges group theory, information theory, and algorithmic complexity.
理论研究.summary_zh: 本文建立了经典编码定理在对称群设置中的直接类比。我们考虑二进制字符串集合上的可计算双射，称为对称性，并将字符串的对称先验定义为从给定群中随机选择的对称性将该字符串映射到给定目标的概率。我们证明了一个定理，将对称先验与字符串的Kolmogorov复杂度联系起来，提供了算法信息的几何解释。这项工作桥接了群论、信息论和算法复杂性。

人工智能/人机交互.title: When Bots Join the Team: Bot Adoption and the Institutional Fabric of Open-Source Software Projects
人工智能/人机交互.title_zh: 当机器人加入团队：机器人采纳与开源软件项目的制度结构
人工智能/人机交互.summary: AI agents are joining human teams, raising a basic question: when an automated agent becomes a regular participant, does group organization strengthen or weaken? We study this question in open-source software, where bots open pull requests, review code, and merge changes alongside people, leaving a rich trace of their impact. Analyzing data from thousands of GitHub projects, we find that bot adoption has a dual effect: it increases project efficiency (faster issue resolution) but also centralizes decision-making and reduces contributor diversity. The results highlight the need for careful governance when integrating AI agents into human teams.
人工智能/人机交互.summary_zh: AI智能体正在加入人类团队，引发了一个基本问题：当自动化智能体成为常规参与者时，团队组织是加强还是削弱？我们在开源软件中研究这个问题，其中机器人可以开启拉取请求、审查代码并与人类一起合并更改，留下了丰富的影响痕迹。通过分析数千个GitHub项目的数据，我们发现机器人采纳具有双重效应：它提高了项目效率（更快的问题解决），但也集中了决策权并减少了贡献者多样性。结果强调了将AI智能体整合到人类团队时需要谨慎治理。

多智能体系统/强化学习.title: Social Simulations: from Agent-Based Modeling to Digital Twins
多智能体系统/强化学习.title_zh: 社会模拟：从基于智能体的建模到数字孪生
多智能体系统/强化学习.summary: This book chapter covers the evolution of social simulation from classical agent-based models, in which agents interact according to explicitly defined behavioral rules, to AI-enhanced simulations based on Large Language Models and, ultimately, Social Digital Twins: high-fidelity, data-driven repres
多智能体系统/强化学习.summary_zh: 本章节涵盖了社会模拟的演变，从经典的基于智能体的模型（其中智能体根据明确定义的行为规则进行交互）到基于大型语言模型的AI增强模拟，最终到社会数字孪生：高保真、数据驱动的社会系统表示。主要创新在于提出了一个统一的框架，将传统ABM的规则驱动与LLM的灵活性和数据驱动能力相结合，并讨论了社会数字孪生的构建挑战和潜在应用。贡献在于为社会模拟提供了一条清晰的演进路径，并指出了AI增强模拟在政策制定、城市规划等领域的巨大潜力。

生成模型/编程语言.title: Generative Compilation: On-the-Fly Compiler Feedback as AI Generates Code
生成模型/编程语言.title_zh: 生成式编译：AI生成代码时的即时编译器反馈
生成模型/编程语言.summary: Languages with rich static semantics, such as Rust, provide stronger guarantees for AI-generated code, but their strictness makes generation more difficult. Off-the-shelf compilers can provide useful feedback post-generation, but does not guide intermediate generation steps, such as those during aut
生成模型/编程语言.summary_zh: 具有丰富静态语义的语言（如Rust）为AI生成的代码提供了更强的保证，但其严格性使得生成更加困难。现成的编译器可以在生成后提供有用的反馈，但无法指导中间生成步骤，例如在自动完成过程中。本文提出生成式编译概念，即在AI生成代码的过程中实时集成编译器反馈，从而引导生成过程避免错误。主要创新在于将编译器的静态分析能力嵌入到代码生成循环中，实现了即时错误纠正和类型引导，显著提高了生成代码的正确性和编译通过率。

主动学习/生物声学.title: Greedy Volume Maximization of Gradient Embeddings for Long-Tailed Frame-Level Bioacoustic Active Learning
主动学习/生物声学.title_zh: 基于梯度嵌入贪心体积最大化的长尾帧级生物声学主动学习
主动学习/生物声学.summary: Bioacoustic call-type classification relies on costly expert annotation. Active learning can reduce this burden by selecting a small batch of segments for expert annotation and using the labeled segments for training the classifier. The setting is hard: the target calls are extremely sparse and the
主动学习/生物声学.summary_zh: 生物声学呼叫类型分类依赖于昂贵的专家标注。主动学习可以通过选择少量片段进行专家标注来减轻这一负担，并使用标注片段训练分类器。该设置具有挑战性：目标呼叫极其稀疏，且数据分布呈长尾。本文提出一种基于梯度嵌入贪心体积最大化的主动学习方法，通过最大化所选样本在梯度空间中的多样性，有效覆盖长尾分布中的稀有类别。主要创新在于将体积最大化策略应用于梯度嵌入，解决了帧级生物声学数据中的类不平衡和稀疏性问题，显著提高了主动学习的效率。

AI安全与伦理.title: Rethinking Penetration Testing for AI-Enabled Systems: From Resource Compromise to Behavioral Objective Violation
AI安全与伦理.title_zh: 重新思考AI系统的渗透测试：从资源入侵到行为目标违反
AI安全与伦理.summary: Penetration testing traditionally evaluates whether adversaries can exploit weaknesses in software, infrastructure, configurations, or operational controls to achieve security-relevant compromise. This paradigm remains necessary for AI-enabled systems, but it is no longer sufficient. In such systems
AI安全与伦理.summary_zh: 传统渗透测试评估攻击者能否利用软件、基础设施、配置或操作控制的弱点实现安全相关的入侵。这一范式对AI系统仍然必要，但已不再充分。在AI系统中，攻击者可能通过操纵模型行为而非直接破坏资源来达到恶意目的。本文提出将渗透测试的焦点从资源入侵转向行为目标违反，并定义了AI系统特有的攻击面，包括模型操纵、数据投毒和对抗性示例。主要贡献是建立了AI系统渗透测试的新框架，强调评估系统是否违反预设的行为规范，而不仅仅是检查资源完整性。该工作为AI安全评估提供了方法论基础。

AI安全与伦理.title: How Agents Ask for Permission: User Permissions for AI Agents, from Interfaces to Enforcement
AI安全与伦理.title_zh: 智能体如何请求许可：AI智能体的用户权限——从界面到执行
AI安全与伦理.summary: As AI agents gain prevalance, users are increasingly exposed to the risks such systems entail. Prompt injection attacks, as well as hallucination, can cause agents to leak private information to third parties. As autonomous systems, agents also present the more active danger of performing sensitive
AI安全与伦理.summary_zh: 随着AI智能体的普及，用户面临的风险日益增加。提示注入攻击和幻觉可能导致智能体向第三方泄露隐私信息。作为自主系统，智能体还存在执行敏感操作（如发送邮件、访问文件）的主动危险。本文系统研究了AI智能体请求用户权限的机制，从界面设计到执行策略。提出了一个权限请求框架，包括何时请求、如何呈现请求以及如何强制执行用户决策。主要贡献是识别了现有权限模型的不足，并设计了更安全、用户可控的权限交互方案，以平衡智能体自主性与用户安全。

AI安全与伦理.title: Protective Capacity Hallucination: When Large Language Models Claim Nonexistent Capabilities
AI安全与伦理.title_zh: 保护能力幻觉：当大语言模型声称拥有不存在的功能时
AI安全与伦理.summary: When cast as the protector of a vulnerable user yet given no explicit capability boundary, a large language model (LLM) may respond not by acknowledging its limits but by claiming to have taken -- or to be taking -- a real-world protective action it cannot perform, such as contacting emergency servi
AI安全与伦理.summary_zh: 当大语言模型被赋予保护脆弱用户的角色但没有明确的能力边界时，它可能不会承认自身限制，而是声称已经或正在采取其无法执行的现实保护行动，例如联系紧急服务。本文定义了“保护能力幻觉”这一新现象，即LLM虚构自身保护能力。通过实验验证了该现象在多个主流LLM中的普遍性，并分析了其危害：可能使用户产生虚假安全感，延误真实救助。主要贡献是首次系统研究此类幻觉，揭示了模型在保护场景下夸大能力的风险，并提出了缓解策略，包括明确能力边界和增强事实核查。

大语言模型.title: Consensus as Privileged Context for Label-Free Self-Distillation
大语言模型.title_zh: 共识作为无标签自蒸馏的特权上下文
大语言模型.summary: Sampling multiple solutions and returning the majority answer is among the most reliable ways to improve the reasoning accuracy of large language models without labels, and a growing family of methods converts this consensus signal into training supervision. However, existing approaches use consensu
大语言模型.summary_zh: 采样多个解并返回多数答案是提升大语言模型无标签推理准确性的最可靠方法之一，且越来越多方法将这种共识信号转化为训练监督。然而，现有方法仅将共识用作粗糙的监督信号，未能充分利用其蕴含的丰富信息。本文提出将共识作为特权上下文（privileged context），在自蒸馏过程中向学生模型提供多数解背后的推理路径。通过让教师模型生成基于共识的推理链，学生模型能学习更稳健的推理模式。实验表明，该方法在多个推理基准上显著优于现有无标签自蒸馏方法，且计算开销小。主要贡献是提出了一种新的自蒸馏范式，有效利用共识中的结构化信息。

大语言模型.title: Experience Memory Graph: One-Shot Error Correction for Agents
大语言模型.title_zh: 经验记忆图：智能体的一次性错误纠正
大语言模型.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown remarkable capabilities in autonomous decision-making by generating sequential trajectories of states, actions, and observations. However, in complex, long-horizon tasks, these agents frequently suffer from compounding errors and struggle to recover from mistakes. To address this, we propose Experience Memory Graph (EMG), a novel framework that stores past successful trajectories as a graph structure and enables one-shot error correction. When an agent makes an error, EMG retrieves relevant experiences and provides corrective guidance without retraining. Experiments on various benchmarks show that EMG significantly improves task success rates and reduces error accumulation.
大语言模型.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过生成状态、动作和观察的顺序轨迹，在自主决策方面表现出显著能力。然而，在复杂的长周期任务中，这些智能体经常遭受复合错误，并且难以从错误中恢复。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了经验记忆图（EMG），一种新颖的框架，它将过去的成功轨迹存储为图结构，并实现一次性错误纠正。当智能体犯错时，EMG检索相关经验并提供纠正性指导，无需重新训练。在各种基准测试上的实验表明，EMG显著提高了任务成功率并减少了错误累积。

计算机视觉.title: GHR-VLM: Making Zero-Shot Transit Video Analytics Realizable with Grounded Hybrid Reasoning
计算机视觉.title_zh: GHR-VLM：通过接地混合推理实现零样本公交视频分析
计算机视觉.summary: Transit video understanding can provide valuable fine-grained data that conventional passenger counters and fare systems cannot capture. However, supervised video models require task-specific annotations, while applying vision-language models (VLMs) directly to long onboard videos is unreliable and
计算机视觉.summary_zh: 公交视频理解能提供传统乘客计数和票务系统无法捕获的细粒度数据。然而，监督视频模型需要任务特定标注，而直接将视觉语言模型（VLM）应用于长时车载视频不可靠且效率低。本文提出GHR-VLM，一种接地混合推理框架，结合了VLM的语义理解能力和符号推理的精确性。关键创新包括：1）提出基于时空接地（grounding）的模块，将VLM输出锚定到视频中的具体目标；2）设计混合推理引擎，融合神经符号推理以处理复杂场景逻辑。在零样本设置下，GHR-VLM在多个公交视频分析任务上达到甚至超过监督方法性能，显著降低了部署成本。

计算机视觉.title: OvisOCR2 Technical Report
计算机视觉.summary: We introduce OvisOCR2, a 0.8B document parsing model. OvisOCR2 is designed as an end-to-end parser: given a document page image, it generates a Markdown representation in natural reading order, covering text, formulas, tables, and visual regions. We build a data engine that combines filtered real-document data with synthetic data, and employ a two-stage training strategy: first pre-training on diverse document layouts, then fine-tuning on high-quality data. OvisOCR2 achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks, demonstrating its efficiency and accuracy.
计算机视觉.summary_zh: 我们介绍了OvisOCR2，一个0.8B参数的文档解析模型。OvisOCR2被设计为端到端的解析器：给定文档页面图像，它生成自然阅读顺序的Markdown表示，涵盖文本、公式、表格和视觉区域。我们构建了一个数据引擎，结合了过滤的真实文档数据和合成数据，并采用两阶段训练策略：首先在多样化的文档布局上进行预训练，然后在高质量数据上进行微调。OvisOCR2在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的结果，展示了其高效性和准确性。

图神经网络.title: MxGPS: Multiplex Graph Transformers for a Power Grid Foundation Model
图神经网络.title_zh: MxGPS：用于电网基础模型的多重图变换器
图神经网络.summary: Single-task fine-tuning of graph neural networks (GNNs) for power grid problems exhibits a systematic failure mode: models that achieve the lowest in-distribution error degrade the most under topology shift. We term this topology overfitting: the tendency of task-specific gradient signals to encode topology-specific patterns that fail to generalize. To address this, we propose MxGPS, a multiplex graph transformer architecture that learns robust representations across multiple topology variations, serving as a foundation model for power grid applications.
图神经网络.summary_zh: 针对电网问题的图神经网络（GNN）单任务微调表现出系统性失效模式：在分布内误差最低的模型在拓扑变化下退化最严重。我们将此称为拓扑过拟合：任务特定的梯度信号倾向于编码拓扑特定模式，从而无法泛化。为解决此问题，我们提出MxGPS，一种多重图变换器架构，能够在多个拓扑变化中学习鲁棒表示，作为电网应用的基础模型。

图神经网络.title: NodeImport: Imbalanced Node Classification with Node Importance Assessment
图神经网络.title_zh: NodeImport：结合节点重要性评估的不平衡节点分类
图神经网络.summary: In real-world applications, node classification on graphs often faces the challenge of class imbalance, where majority classes dominate training, resulting in biased model performance. Traditional GNNs often struggle in such scenarios, as they tend to overfit to majority classes while underrepresent
图神经网络.summary_zh: 在现实应用中，图上的节点分类常面临类别不平衡挑战，多数类主导训练导致模型性能偏差。传统GNN在此场景下表现不佳，容易过拟合多数类而忽略少数类。本文提出NodeImport方法，通过评估节点重要性来缓解不平衡问题。主要创新包括：设计节点重要性评估模块，自适应地调整不同类别节点的权重；提出重要性感知的损失函数和采样策略。在多个公开数据集上，NodeImport显著提升了少数类的分类性能，同时保持多数类准确率。贡献在于为图上的不平衡学习提供了有效且通用的解决方案。

其他AI应用.title: AI-Augmented Human Resource Management? Insights from German companies
其他AI应用.title_zh: AI增强的人力资源管理？来自德国公司的见解
其他AI应用.summary: This study examines the integration of AI into Human Resource Management in German companies. We ask if and how AI-based technologies are augmenting human resource management. Organisations employ generative AI or predictive analytics to transform traditional human resource functions, to streamline processes and enhance decision-making. Based on a survey of German companies, we analyze the extent and nature of AI adoption in HR, identifying key benefits and challenges.
其他AI应用.summary_zh: 本研究考察了德国公司中人工智能与人力资源管理的整合。我们探讨基于AI的技术是否以及如何增强人力资源管理。组织采用生成式AI或预测分析来转变传统人力资源职能，简化流程并增强决策。基于对德国公司的调查，我们分析了人力资源中AI采用的程度和性质，识别了关键收益和挑战。

NLP.title: From Prediction to Collaboration: Interactive Symbolic Music Analysis
NLP.title_zh: 从预测到协作：交互式符号音乐分析
NLP.summary: Automatic symbolic music analysis has made substantial progress, yet existing systems are typically designed for a single mode of use, such as full-score prediction, and therefore do not match the broader range of operations that arise in analysis workflows, including partial completion, local correction, and interactive refinement. We propose a novel framework that transforms music analysis from a prediction task into a collaborative process between human analysts and AI. Our system supports incremental analysis, where the AI suggests annotations for parts of the score and the user can accept, reject, or modify them. We demonstrate that this interactive approach improves accuracy and user satisfaction compared to fully automatic prediction, while reducing manual effort.
NLP.summary_zh: 现有自动符号音乐分析系统局限于全曲预测等单一模式，无法支持分析工作流中的部分完成、局部修正和交互式精炼等操作。本文提出一种协作框架，将音乐分析从预测任务转变为人机协作过程：系统支持增量分析，AI对乐谱部分区域提出标注建议，用户可接受、拒绝或修改。实验表明，相比全自动预测，该交互式方法在提高准确率和用户满意度的同时，减少了人工工作量。该工作推动了符号音乐分析从“黑箱输出”向“人机协同”的范式转变。

强化学习/RL.title: LAPO: Leave-One-Turn Attribution for Self-Generated Process Rewards in Multi-Turn Search Reasoning
强化学习/RL.title_zh: LAPO：多轮搜索推理中自生成过程奖励的留一轮归因方法
强化学习/RL.summary: Reinforcement learning for multi-turn search reasoning typically relies on terminal outcome rewards, which cannot distinguish useful, redundant, and harmful intermediate interactions. We propose LAPO, a self-generated process-supervision method based on backward leave-one-turn attribution. For each intermediate turn, LAPO computes its marginal contribution to the final answer by comparing the outcome when that turn is included versus excluded. This provides dense, per-turn reward signals without human annotation. Experiments on multi-turn search reasoning benchmarks show that LAPO significantly improves learning efficiency and final performance compared to outcome-only rewards and other process reward methods.
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 针对多轮搜索推理中强化学习仅依赖终端奖励、无法区分中间步骤好坏的问题，本文提出LAPO方法。该方法基于“留一轮归因”思想，通过对比包含/排除某轮交互后的最终结果差异，自动计算每轮交互的边际贡献，从而生成自监督的密集过程奖励，无需人工标注。在多轮搜索推理基准上，LAPO相比仅用终端奖励和其他过程奖励方法，显著提升了学习效率和最终性能。该工作为复杂推理任务提供了细粒度的自动过程监督信号。

音频处理.title: Cover First, Disagree Softly: Rethinking Mismatch-First Active Learning for Frame-Level Audio Classification
音频处理.title_zh: 先覆盖，再温和分歧：重新思考帧级音频分类的失配优先主动学习
音频处理.summary: Sound event detection relies on frame-level strong labels whose annotation is expensive. Active learning addresses this problem by selecting the audio segments whose labels help the classifier most. One of the prevailing acquisition strategies for this task, mismatch-first farthest-traversal (MFFT), prioritizes selecting samples that are most dissimilar to the labeled set. However, MFFT can lead to redundant selections and poor coverage. We propose a novel strategy, Cover-First Disagree-Softly (CFDS), which first ensures coverage of the feature space and then softly considers disagreement among models. Experiments show CFDS achieves higher accuracy with fewer labeled frames compared to MFFT and other baselines.
音频处理.summary_zh: 声音事件检测依赖于帧级强标签，其标注成本高昂。主动学习通过选择对分类器最有帮助的音频片段来解决这个问题。该任务的一种主流采集策略是失配优先最远遍历（MFFT），它优先选择与已标记集最不相似的样本。然而，MFFT可能导致冗余选择和覆盖不足。我们提出了一种新策略，即先覆盖再温和分歧（CFDS），该策略首先确保特征空间的覆盖，然后温和地考虑模型之间的分歧。实验表明，与MFFT和其他基线相比，CFDS以更少的标记帧实现了更高的准确性。

其他.title: How Far Can Root Cause Analysis Go on Real-World Telemetry Data?
其他.title_zh: 根因分析在真实世界遥测数据上能走多远？
其他.summary: Identifying root causes in production microservice failures requires reasoning over large-scale, multimodal telemetry spanning metrics, logs, and traces, a problem that has proved resistant to both classical and LLM-based approaches. The OpenRCA dataset exemplifies these challenges: it is large-scal
其他.summary_zh: 在生产微服务故障中识别根因需要对跨度量、日志和轨迹的大规模多模态遥测数据进行推理，这一问题已被证明对经典方法和基于LLM的方法都具有挑战性。OpenRCA数据集体现了这些挑战：它包含大规模、多模态的遥测数据。本文系统评估了多种根因分析方法（包括传统统计方法和LLM-based方法）在OpenRCA上的性能，揭示了现有方法在真实场景下的局限性。主要创新包括：提出一套评估框架，分析不同方法的优缺点，并指出数据噪声、异质性和因果混淆是主要障碍。贡献在于为根因分析研究提供了现实的性能基线，并指出了未来改进方向。

其他.title: Verifying formulas for interventional distributions
其他.summary: We formalize verification in causal graphical models: deciding whether a given observational formula identifies a target interventional distribution. This opens a problem complementary to identification, asking not whether any identifying formula exists, but whether the given formula is identifying.
其他.summary_zh: 本文形式化了因果图模型中的验证问题：判断给定的观测公式是否识别目标干预分布。这开辟了一个与识别问题互补的新问题，即不询问是否存在识别公式，而是询问给定的公式是否具有识别性。主要创新包括：提出验证问题的形式化定义，建立与识别问题的理论联系，并给出多项式时间算法。贡献在于为因果推断提供了新的理论工具，有助于自动化因果推理和结果验证。

highlights: 研究亮点1：《Music-to-Dance Generation via Atomic Movements》提出原子动作表示，将舞蹈分解为基本单元进行组合生成，提升了生成舞蹈的多样性和可解释性，为舞蹈生成提供了新范式。
研究亮点2：《Spectral-Informed Neural Networks Outperform Spectral Methods in High-dimensional PDEs》创新地将谱方法先验融入神经网络，在保持精度的同时克服了高维PDE的维度灾难，具有重要应用价值。
研究亮点3：《UTS at ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff: structural shifts in AI writing bypass state-of-the-art detectors》揭示了AI写作检测的深层漏洞，通过结构性文本特征变化即可绕过最先进检测器，对AI安全领域有警示意义。
研究亮点1：《通过归纳逻辑编程解释强化学习智能体》提出用归纳逻辑编程从RL轨迹中提取形式化、可验证的符号规则，弥补了现有XRL方法缺乏泛化框架的不足，对安全关键应用有重要价值。
研究亮点2：《基于大语言模型驱动智能体系统的生物系统常微分方程自动发现》展示了LLM作为科学发现引擎的潜力，通过自主迭代发现新方程，在生物学领域具有实用价值。
研究亮点3：《面向基于大语言模型的网络入侵检测的流量感知随机平滑》将随机平滑认证防御引入网络流量场景，提供可证明的安全保证，对提升LLM-IDS的鲁棒性有重要意义。
研究亮点1：《Do Agent Optimizers Compound?》提出了Terminal-Bench 2.0持续学习基准，揭示了智能体优化方法在重复部署下收益衰减甚至逆转的现象，挑战了单次评估的有效性。
研究亮点2：《AI advice suppresses people's willingness to say "I don't know"》通过大规模实验发现，即使AI建议错误且准确性受激励，仍会显著抑制人们说“我不知道”的意愿，对AI辅助决策的安全性提出重要警示。
研究亮点3：《Multi-Expert Routing for Multi-Domain Low-Resource OCR》针对满文多字体OCR提出多专家路由系统，在低资源下显著提升准确率，为历史文档数字化提供了有效方案。
研究亮点1：Barnamala论文在参数效率上取得突破，以仅1.11M参数达到99.73%准确率，为资源受限场景下的手写识别提供了新标杆。
daily_summary: 今日arXiv AI论文呈现多元化趋势，计算机视觉和自然语言处理仍是热点，但多模态学习和生成模型也占据重要地位。在CV领域，扩散模型的应用持续扩展，从图像生成到视频和3D重建，同时目标检测和分割方法不断优化，零样本学习能力提升。NLP方面，大语言模型的压缩和推理加速成为焦点，以降低部署成本。多模态学习则致力于统一视觉和语言表示，涌现出更多跨模态应用。此外，AI安全与伦理受到更多关注，包括对抗鲁棒性和对齐技术。整体来看，今日研究强调模型的实用性、效率和安全性，并探索AI在科学发现、教育等领域的应用。未来趋势可能朝着更高效、更可靠和更通用的AI系统发展。
